name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-law
description: Laws in your memory. Pick a US city or county (LOCUS v1, UC Berkeley, CC BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial use), a French national code (LEGI, Légifrance data, Licence Ouverte 2.0), an Act of the UK Parliament, a Canadian federal Act (English or French), an EU regulation, an international treaty (UN, human rights, Geneva Conventions, EU treaties), or a national law of Colombia, Spain, Argentina, Italy or Portugal (official sources, through Legalize, Normattiva and Justice Canada): MnemoLaw downloads the texts and keeps them in your knowledge folder and in one memory pack per country. It quotes texts and gives no legal advice.

descriptionI18n.es: Las leyes en tu memoria. Elige una ciudad o un condado de Estados Unidos (LOCUS v1, UC Berkeley, CC BY-NC-4.0, uso no comercial) o un código nacional francés (LEGI, datos de Légifrance, Licence Ouverte 2.0): MnemoLaw descarga los textos y los guarda en tu carpeta de conocimientos y en un paquete de memoria por país. Cita textos y no da asesoramiento jurídico.

agentGuide: Name a city, a county or a law the way the person says it (« Austin », « code civil », « C-46 »): importPlace finds it in the country's list by its words, a key from findPlaces works too. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.

To look at something: openCountry for a country's screen, showHome for the countries, showRequest for the screen that asks for another country (the person sends it), openFolder for the folder where the laws are kept.

To put a law in memory: loadPlaces for its country (when status or countries says the list is not loaded), then importPlace with its name, in the same steps. importPlace answers started; status says the outcome; stop stops it.

The US cities and counties need the LOCUS licence accepted by the person on the United States screen: never accepted for them, a refusal LICENSE_NOT_ACCEPTED means show the US screen and let them read it.
MnemoLaw quotes texts and gives no legal advice: a question about what a law says goes to the chat, which reads the laws in memory.

agentActions.summary: Say what MnemoLaw shows and holds: the country on screen, the download running, and the laws already in memory
agentActions.details: inMemory lists every city, county or law put in memory with its articles kept and in the vault. onScreen is what the last import said. usLicenceAccepted is null while the library is being read.

agentActions.details: us = US cities and counties (LOCUS, the person accepts its licence on screen), fr = French codes, uk, ca, eu, int, co, es, ar, it, pt = national laws.
